description: PAID (~$0.02 via x402). The same signed live UMA settlement-risk record as the free predge_settlement_risk tool, WITH settlement_estimate: a statistic computed from 2026 Polymarket UMA disputes (market price before the first dispute + market type). A statistic, not advice. GET /v1/settlement-risk/:market/estimate. The tool re-checks the ed25519 signature and returns `{ verification, record }`. Call predge_settlement_risk first (free) and check settlement_estimate_available before paying. With PREDGE_KEY set to a pilot key from https://predge.io/start it is free for 30 days. Param: market (condition id 0x+64 hex, numeric market id, or slug).
name: predge_settlement_estimate
title: Settlement risk + settlement_estimate — signed (paid)
